Constitution of lndia and in pursuance of the decision taken by the Hon'ble
Cabinet in its meeting vide No.CAB/M-1L1812O26 dated 13th August, 2026, the
Governor of Arunachal Pradesh is pleased to approve and notify the adoption
of uniform eligibility criteria for Direct Recruitment through the competitive
examinations to all posts/services under the Government of Arunachal
Pradesh, including State Government Departments, Public Sector
Undertakings (PSUs), Autonomous Bodies, and Local/Urban Bodies.
1.. MANDATORY ELIGIBILITY CRITERIA FOR DIRECT RECRUITMENT
Every candidate applying for direct recruitment to any post under the
Government of Arunachal Pradesh, Public Sector Undertakings, Autonomous
Bodies, and Local/Urban Bodies must satisfy the following conditions:
(i) Permanent Residence Criterion: -
The candidate must be a citizen of lndia and an inhabitant of Arunachal
Pradesh holding a valid Permanent Residence Cefiilicate (PRC) of Arunachal
Pradesh issued by the designated Competent Authority under the
Government of Arunachal Pradesh.
(ii) lndigenous Status and Arunachal Pradesh Scheduled Tribe Criterion:
The candidate must be an original inhabitant of Arunachal Pradesh and hold
an Arunachal Pradesh Scheduled Tribe (APST) Certificate issued by the
Competent Authority of the Government of Arunachal Pradesh, as per the list
of Tribes notified by the Government of lndia in the Constitution (Scheduled
Tribes) Order, 1950, as amended from time to time.
(iii) Indigenous Tribal Language Proficiency Criterion: '
The candidate must be able to speak any of the lndigenous Tribal Languages
of Arunachal Pradesh as per the list of Tribal Languages notified by the
Government of India under the Constitution of lndia Scheduled Tribes Order,
1950, as amended from time to time and must possess working knowledge of
the local indigenous tribes.

NOTIFICATION
2. IMPLEMENTATION MECHANISM FOR LANGUAGE TEST
Until such time that the Arunachal Pradesh Scheduled Tribes Language
Proficiency Test is formally structured in a written format as part of the initial
Competitive Examination, the following mechanism shall govern Language
Proficie ncy Eval uation : -
1. Post-Joining Probation Period: - A mandatory Language Test shall be
conducted after the candidate joins seruice, within a probation/stipulated
period of three (3) years.
2. Consequences of Non-Compliance: - Failure to pass the Language
Test within the Probation/stipulated period of three (3) years shall result
in the withholding of annual increments and further promotions until the
candidate successfully passes in any notified Arunachal Pradesh
Scheduled language.
3. APPLICABILITY & COMPLIANCE
1. The Arunachal Pradesh Public Service Commission (APPSC) and the
Arunachal Pradesh Staff Selection Board (APSSB) shall immediately
incorporate these mandatory eligibility clauses and post-joining
Language Test Mechanisms in all future recruitment advertisements and
rules.
2. These rules shall be applicable to all the Recruitment Rules/ Service
Rules of Group 'A', 'B' and 'C' posts/ services and equivalents with
immediate effect.
(By order and in the name of the Governor of Arunachal Pradesh)
